candidates.name: Stargardt disease
support_spans: symmetric hypoautofluorescent lesions with hyperautofluorescent borders in the central macula bilaterally
thinning of the outer nuclear layer in the fovea
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results are consistent with Stargardt disease, a juvenile macular degeneration disorder.

candidates.name: cone-rod dystrophy
support_spans: central scotoma in both eyes
attenuated photopic responses and 30-Hz flicker responses with delayed implicit times in both eyes
candidates.why: The patient's visual field defects and electroretinography results are consistent with cone-rod dystrophy, a progressive retinal disorder.

candidates.name: Leber congenital amaurosis
support_spans: lifelong uncorrectable visual acuity and color vision impairment
progressive blurred central vision and color vision defects
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and family history are consistent with Leber congenital amaurosis, a rare inherited eye disease caused by mutations in the RPE65 gene.

candidates.name: retinitis pigmentosa
support_spans: night blindness and progressive vision loss
electronegative waveform in the dark-adapted 3.0 ERG
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and electroretinography results are consistent with retinitis pigmentosa, a group of genetic disorders that affect the retina.

candidates.name: choroideremia
support_spans: macular atrophy and lesions bilaterally
loss of the ellipsoid zone and collapse of the outer nuclear layer in the central macula bilaterally
candidates.why: The patient's imaging results are consistent with choroideremia, a rare inherited disorder that causes progressive loss of the choroid and retina.

candidates.name: Bietti crystalline dystrophy
support_spans: crystalline deposits in the retina
progressive vision loss and night blindness
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results are consistent with Bietti crystalline dystrophy, a rare inherited disorder that causes progressive loss of vision.
